hook: 把 our（我們的）當主角——臭臉老爸正在大掃除。
script: 我們的（our）豪宅裡，dour 老爸臉臭到能醃菜；他一邊 scour 刷地板，一邊把酸掉的情緒 pour 進水桶。空氣整間 sour，他還 lour／lower 著眉。最後全家只好 mourn：歡樂已死。

members.speakLineEn: Critics should not pour scorn on a draft before reading it carefully.
members.speakLineZh: 批評者不該在細讀前就對草稿大潑冷水／嘲弄。

members.speakLineEn: The partnership soured when incentives were misaligned.
members.speakLineZh: 誘因錯位後，這段合作關係變質了。

members.senseAnchor: a place that is scoured (especially by running water); examine minutely
members.speakLineEn: Investigators scoured the records for inconsistencies.
members.speakLineZh: 調查人員徹底翻查紀錄找矛盾。

members.senseAnchor: stubbornly unyielding; ; ; ; - T.S.Eliot; harshly uninviting or formidable in manner or appearance; ; ; ; - J.M.Barrie
members.speakLineEn: His dour expression never softened during negotiations.
members.speakLineZh: 談判時他那張冷酷臉始終沒鬆過。

related.synonyms: dogged, persistent, pertinacious, tenacious, unyielding, forbidding
related.antonyms: caducous, yielding, irresolute, unretentive, allow, permit

members.senseAnchor: feel sadness; observe the customs of mourning after the death of a loved one
members.speakLineEn: Critics mourned the decline of careful argumentation.
members.speakLineZh: 評論者哀悼嚴謹論證的衰落。

pitfalls: lour/lower（皺眉）口語少見，先主攻 dour/scour
